Hi all — adding tax perspective. A few clarifications that will speed processing: 

1) US person vs. foreign entity: If Peregrine is a US person (sounds like a US C-Corp), a properly completed W-9 is sufficient for FATCA/chapter 4 and chapter 61 reporting — no W-8 form is required.

2) EIN mismatch: Backup withholding is triggered only when the payee furnishes an incorrect TIN or fails to furnish a TIN after reasonable requests. If the EIN on the W-9 doesn't match our IRS-matching file, AP will hold payment until we get either: corrected W-9 or an IRS letter that reconciles the EIN.

3) 1099 reporting: We will report payments to entities classified as reportable recipients. For corporations, typically 1099-MISC/Form 1099-NEC is not required for corporations except for certain payments — but AP/tax will evaluate based on payment type. We will notify you if 1099 applies.

4) Suggested verifier wording for your reconciliation letter (if you want to send one instead of reissuing W-9):

"To whom it may concern,
Peregrine Labs (EIN: 12-3456789) confirms that 12-3456789 is our federal employer identification number as issued by the IRS. Attached is a copy of our IRS EIN confirmation letter (CP 575) and a signed W-9. Please update your vendor file accordingly.

Sincerely,
[Name], CFO, Peregrine Labs"

If you reissue a corrected W-9 we can attach it to the vendor record and move forward. Marissa — once we have the corrected W-9 and one of the reconciliation docs, can you confirm you'll update the AP vendor record and remove any payment hold?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
